course.title: Operations Research and Systems Analysis
course.department: Department of Urban and Regional Planning

content.value: The time Barber Joe takes to give a haircut is exponential with a mean of 10 minutes. Because of his popularity, customers usually arrive at a rate much higher than Joe can handle, 9 customers per hour which follows Poisson distribution. Joe really will feel comfortable if the arrival rate is effectively reduced to about 5 customers per hour. To accomplish this goal, he came up with the idea of providing limited seating
in the waiting area, so that newly arriving customers will go elsewhere when they discover that all the seats are taken. How many seats should Joe provide to accomplish his goal?

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 3rd Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2022
